output.subject: We've received your message about online banking access
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch, and we're sorry for the stress and frustration this has caused, especially on payday.

We have received your complaint. You told us that both the app and the website had been unavailable since 7 this morning. You mentioned that you needed to send your $1,450 rent payment through bill pay before 5pm today, and that your landlord charges a late fee if it arrives after that. You asked us to explain what was going on and to restore your access so you could send the payment in time.

We understand how worrying it is to face a deadline like this when you can't get into your online banking. A specialist team is reviewing your complaint and will respond within 10 business days.

Thank you for your patience, and for taking the time to let us know.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Time-sensitive: the customer has a same-day 5pm rent deadline. Consider whether someone should contact them today, before or instead of this written reply.
Confirm whether there was a reported app or website outage on the date of the complaint, and when access was restored.
Decide whether to offer alternative ways to make the payment. None are mentioned in the draft because they were not in the complaint.
The customer may raise the landlord's late fee later. The draft makes no commitment about it, so decide how the bank will handle that if it comes up.
Check whether the rent payment was eventually sent, and whether it reached the landlord on time.
Review the 10-business-day wording, given the customer's urgent deadline.
